scope: Emergency removal of the microphone safeguard that rejected working headsets.

topics.title: Microphone compatibility
details: Companion again uses the default microphone selected in Windows. USB, USB-C, Bluetooth, analog jack and internal microphones are eligible when Windows supplies a usable audio input.

topics.title: Working headsets no longer blocked
details: Removed the external-only hardware identification check. A submitted diagnostic confirmed a Jabra Evolve2 30 input could open at 44100 Hz even though the safeguard disabled voice commands. This change removes that false rejection; it does not claim to repair external hardware classification.

topics.title: Keyboard fallback and existing fixes
details: Keyboard navigation remains available if the microphone cannot open. The previous browser, list navigation, startup guidance and typed-only website address, email address and password protections remain in place.

topics.title: Validation
details: Regression checks cover the reported Jabra input and default input selection across microphone types. Windows build and consumer tests run before publication. Actual recognition accuracy depends on the selected microphone and environment.
